reviews.text: ​It was my first time using this service, and unfortunately, it was a very bad experience. On Saturday, August 1, 2026, I took my dog in for a haircut. When we returned home, I noticed he was moving his head strangely, but by Sunday morning it got worse and he started bleeding. I couldn't post this sooner due to a lack of time. I'm sure they will claim the dog moved or that it isn't their fault, but this is the first time something like this has ever happened to us—we've never had a similar incident anywhere else.
You do amazing job thank you so much for everything you do.

I want to give a big SHOUT OUT AND THANK YOU to Top Flight Paw Salon for taking such good care of my dog, Osita! I absolutely love the results - her haircut ooks amazing! I can tell she was treated well because she came home happy, looking great and smelling wonderful. Thank you for the awesome service and for taking such good care of my girl!♥️♥️ I totally recommend this place!!
Good service my puppy was the same as I wanted it as always leaves it I recommend it I have a long time that I bring it here and I like it

I hate to do this but quality has gone down tremendously! They must have either changed groomers or owners cuz I've never had my dogs look this bad before! I told them a summer cut short, trim the tail and ears and round the face. Same as always for the past at least 3 years. They shaved their tails off! Didn't touch the ears, not even brushed because they have knots from the washing. And his face/cheeks is crooked. I saw it as soon as I left and went back for them to fix it. He came back worse! They trimmed the other side that was short already, not the long side. My girl is all choppy and her head is not blended to the body with a big indent on her neck and their feet are not a pretty rounded shape like they were in the past. Unfortunately, they've lost my business. Oh, and I'm pretty sure they do not treat them nicely because every time I took them, they always have accidents out of fear! Go at your own risk.

Top notch grooming love the service our family take all the dogs there  , I highly recommend this place take my word for it , good people who love dogs and the results are in the pudding around of applause for everybody who works there , my dogs name is Bella Diaz

The next time I came I specifically let them know to not cut my dog’s belly because she got irritated from the shaving and the cut. Our first time trying this location:) so far we like it:)

I couldn’t be happier with the grooming service! My girl looks absolutely adorable 🥰 clean, fresh, and styled with the cutest little bows. The attention to detail, from the perfect trim to the gentle care shown, really stood out. She came home happy and comfortable, which tells me she was well taken care of. Thank you for making her look and feel amazing 💜 . I’m so glad to support a wonderful neighborhood business that puts so much love into what they do. Highly recommend! 🐾✨
Very nice service & satisfied with the new look for my 2 Golden Doodle.

Horrible service! Gave them a try again only because they’re in the area (I shouldn’t have) Consistently bad service. Not open when they say they’ll be open. Confirmed appointment and they were closed. Called to speak with someone and no response! They’re awful! If I had the option of no stars that would be my rating.

They never called me to say there was an emergency. That’s complete BS! My pet’s grooming was at 8am. I was there at 7:45am. They never opened. I called the week prior to confirm they had my pet on the schedule and the woman I spoke with confirmed the appointment - name, phone number etc.
I like how they mentioned they unexpectedly had to close early. Ha! They were never open to begin with and I doubt any calls were made.just trying to save face.
Thanks! My pet is better off not going there.

I want to thank you for the service you provided. You treated my Chihuahua very well; she's like my daughter to me, and when I picked her up, she was so happy. I truly recommend you without hesitation. Excellent service! ❤️❤️
Great service! I've been taking my dog ​​there for two years and it's an excellent service. Thank you so much for the great service, I highly recommend them! 👍🏼👍🏼 …

I have taken my dogs here for a few years now, but recently the lack of care has gone downhill. The past 2 times my dogs have been here, they had to be taken to the vet the next day due to injuries obtained here. The first time, they had cut my dogs ears in multiple places causing bleeding and then told me my dog injured himself. The vet said these injuries were caused by a sharp object such as clippers. This next time, both of my dogs obtained rashes which the vet said is caused by a razer or an unclean object. Both my dogs are having a hard time walking and this rash is causing extreme discomfort. Please do not bring your dogs here unless you want them to leave with cuts and rashes.
They do good work
I've been taking my dog ​​there for a long time and the service is excellent. They're always friendly and meet all my expectations. 100% recommended.

I took both of my dogs to this place for a shower and haircut. Unfortunately, I had a very upsetting experience. My female dog had her ear cut, and my male dog had a large cut near his tail. I didn’t notice the injuries immediately, but discovered them a few days later.

I’m very disappointed with the lack of care and attention. I urge anyone bringing their pets here to thoroughly check them before leaving the premises. Please be careful and make sure your pets are handled with the gentleness they deserve.
The best Nico loves it! Highly recommended!
10000% recommend . Superior customer service!! Thank you

I took my two girls Bella and Mia there (Japense Chins ) I was very worried they have gone to the same groomer for 20 plus years. At first glance they looked adorable but after two days their hair was standing up straight.They were cut wrong. Receptionist was so helpful and even helped carry my baby to the car. My two boys went on Friday. The body looked good but legs and face to long. They both  have different hair then the girls.
Monday I had to take Simba to the vet he had a large growth by his rectum and two large absesses.  Vet said caused from grooming. Absesses had to be cut and drained. $316.00 and 5 prescriptions. I don't know what to b say or do.
Top Flight what do you say about this ? I never got to meet the groomer. I  asked to talk to him but he didn't come out and you can't see in the back room.
I am very upset and confused.
Excellent service, 100% recommended, and friendly staff.

After months of grooming my own pup- I decided to take her to the professionals!

I truly did love the online booking system - most places, you have to call in, which makes scheduling appointments difficult for me when trying to schedule ahead of time. Top Flight Paws scheduling system was a breeze, and they were attentive of the notes and details I passed over.

Rest assured when I arrived, the front desk notified me they would call me if any problems or issues arrive as I told them this was my pups first time getting professionally groomed! This was such great news - really eased my worries about the entire process. The groom was quick on top of everything as well! She smelled great, and looked beautiful, and I can tell they genuinely love and care for dogs.

They also gave me notes about her behaviors  during the cut (she was nervous, but I knew that coming in) and let me know other helpful information - this will help me prep for bringing her next time. Definitely will be returning!
Excellent with my puppy <3 ! Love this spot for grooming my pets!

Tried a new groomer for my baby, and was not disappointed! Prices are the best I’ve seen and they did a phenomenal job! I was a little uneasy because there’s a wall covering what’s going on in the back but my dog came back fine and well groomed! Definitely somewhere to try!
